title: Re-Shifting of Temporary Powerhouse to new Powerhouse at Manakodam Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations to move the 7.5 kVA DG set, 5 kW solar plant, LT/AMF panels and stabilizer from the temporary power house to the new power house at Manakkodam Lighthouse, Alleppey district, Kerala, including earthing and reconnection of lighthouse loads.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Manakkodam Lighthouse, Andhakaranazhi P.O., Pattanakkadu, Alleppey (Dist.), Pin 688531
sites.work: Re-shifting of temporary power house equipment to new power house

scope.item: Earthing with copper earth plate 600x600x3 mm with masonry enclosure, locking cover, 2.7 m watering pipe (for DG set and lightning conductor for solar panel)
Supplying and laying 25x5 mm copper strip 0.5 m below ground as strip earth electrode (4 earths x 15 m)
Dismantling of 7.5 kVA DG set, EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer and all electrical/electronic switchgear from temporary power house
Shifting of DG set, EAMF panel, stabilizer and switchgear to new power house with labour, machinery and cargo vehicle
Installation of 7.5 kVA single phase DG set, EAMF panel, stabilizer, LT panel and switchgear with wiring and terminations in new power house and LH tower
Dismantling and shifting of 5 kW solar panels incl. GI stand and wiring from temporary power house
Installation of 5 kW solar panels on GI stand on concrete base on top of new power house incl. wiring
Miscellaneous items: screws, bolts, nuts, washers, drill bits, cable ties, bends, tees, cable glands, PVC junction boxes etc.

money.performance_security: 10% of contract value (FDR/BG) within 10 days of award, valid 60 days beyond completion incl. defect liability period
money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any commercial/nationalised bank in favour of Director, Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, payable at Cochin; NSIC/MSME certificate holders for related stores/service exempt. 100% payment within 30 days of satisfactory completion. LD 0.5% of contract value per week, max 10%. Rates to show basic cost and taxes separately; L1 on consolidated total.

period.completion: 45 days from date of issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 60 days from date of opening of quotations

eligibility: Reputed licensed contractors, agencies or government undertakings
Documents: valid electrical licence from KSEB; NSIC/MSME certificate or EMD; PAN; GST registration; work experience of equivalent/similar or higher value; last 3 years ITR
specs: 7.5 kVA single phase DG set, EAMF panel, voltage stabilizer, LT panel; 5 kW solar plant
Wiring per KSEB specifications or CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works 2013 Part-I (Internal); Indian Electricity Act 2003 and Rules 1956
Copper conductors only, fire-resistant insulation, BIS/ISI/IEC compliant; contractor to handle KSEB meter shifting/reconnection (KSEB payments claimable on receipts)
notes: Pages 1-2 scanned NIQ (file no. MS-Coc-26001/1/2019-MS in body, MS-Coc-10001/1/2024-MS in header). NIQ spells station 'Manakodam'. Download 01.07.2024 09:00 to 15.07.2024 14:00; submission 01.07.2024 14:00 to 15.07.2024 15:00; opening 15.07.2024 16:00. Forms 1-6 are boilerplate; PBG form note says 'three percent (10%)'. Work to proceed without interrupting lighthouse equipment operation.
